blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解導入隔離器（Isolator）取代傳統 LAF 無菌充填的業務動機與技術優勢，以及對 CDMO 競爭力的戰略意義。
blocks.en: Understand the business drivers and technical advantages of replacing conventional LAF aseptic filling with an isolator, and what this means strategically for a CDMO's competitiveness.

blocks.zh: 掌握各主要法規市場（美國 PAS、加拿大 Notifiable/SNDS、歐盟 Type II、WHO 中度變更）對此類充填設備重大變更的申報分類與時程要求。
blocks.en: Know the filing classification and timeline requirements for this major change to filling equipment in each key regulatory market (US PAS, Canada Notifiable Change/SNDS, EU Type II, WHO moderate change).

blocks.zh: 理解 PACMP（Post-Approval Change Management Protocol）如何透過監管機關預先同意，將未來每個受影響產品的申報類別從「先批准」降級為「通知即可」，實現商業價值。
blocks.en: Understand how a PACMP (Post-Approval Change Management Protocol) secures advance agreement from the regulator so that the filing category for each affected product is downgraded from "prior approval" to "notification only", which is where the commercial value comes from.

blocks.zh: 能解讀 Figure 12-1 魚骨圖（CQA/CPP 影響圖），說明所有關鍵品質屬性（無菌性、填充重量、微粒、E&L、CCI）在比較性研究設計中的地位。
blocks.en: Be able to read the Figure 12-1 fishbone diagram (CQA/CPP impact diagram) and explain where each critical quality attribute (sterility, fill weight, particulates, E&L, CCI) sits in the design of the comparability study.

blocks.zh: 閱讀並應用 PACMP 文件結構：目的、變更範圍、背景資料（CQA 魚骨）、研究計畫、驗證方法，作為日後自行撰寫或審查 PACMP 的實務框架。
blocks.en: Read and apply the PACMP document structure (purpose, scope of change, background data (CQA fishbone), study plan, validation approach) as a practical framework for writing or reviewing a PACMP yourself.

blocks.zh: 12.0 Appendix 2 Introduction — 附錄2 導言
blocks.en: 12.0 Appendix 2 Introduction

blocks.zh: 導言解析：為什麼這個附錄對你最重要
blocks.en: Introduction: Why This Appendix Matters Most to You

blocks.zh: 核心概念
blocks.en: Key Concept

blocks.zh: 本附錄是整份 TR91 最貼近你日常工作的章節。它不是抽象理論，而是一份「真實世界的劇本」——一家 CDMO 如何把現有的傳統 LAF 充填線，升級為隔離器系統，並同步處理所有已核准產品的申報。
blocks.en: This appendix is the part of TR91 closest to your day-to-day work. It is not abstract theory but a "real-world playbook": how a CDMO upgrades an existing conventional LAF filling line to an isolator system while handling the filings for all approved products at the same time.

blocks.zh: 如果你的廠正在評估隔離器投資，或客戶要求提升無菌保證水準，這就是你需要的法規路徑地圖。
blocks.en: If your site is evaluating an isolator investment, or a customer is asking for a higher level of sterility assurance, this is the regulatory roadmap you need.

blocks.zh: 類比說明
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: LAF 開放式系統就像餐廳的開放式廚房——環境稍有干擾（員工進出、氣流波動）就可能影響食品安全。隔離器則像無塵手術室——完全密封，自動消毒，人員只能透過手套箱操作，污染路徑從根本上被切斷。
blocks.en: An open LAF system is like a restaurant's open kitchen: any disturbance in the environment (staff movement, airflow fluctuation) can put food safety at risk. An isolator is like a clean operating theatre: fully sealed, automatically decontaminated, with personnel working only through glove ports, so the contamination pathway is cut off at its root.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，這不只是品質升級，更是市場定位升級：可以承接更高風險的生物製劑（活性細胞、GMO、毒性療法）。
blocks.en: For a CDMO this is not only a quality upgrade but also an upgrade in market positioning: you can take on higher-risk biologics (live cells, GMOs, toxic therapies).

blocks.zh: 思考題
blocks.en: Discussion Question

blocks.zh: 你的廠目前使用哪一種隔離技術？如果是開放 RABS，隔離器升級的主要障礙是什麼——是 HVAC 改造成本、驗證工時，還是監管申報的不確定性？本附錄的 PACMP 策略如何降低最後那一項風險？
blocks.en: Which barrier technology does your site use today? If it is open RABS, what is the main obstacle to upgrading to an isolator: HVAC retrofit cost, validation effort, or uncertainty in the regulatory filing? How does the PACMP strategy in this appendix reduce that last risk?

blocks.zh: 12.1 Background — 背景說明（已不需單獨標頭；內容見 PACMP Scope of Change）
blocks.en: 12.1 Background (no separate heading needed; see the content under PACMP Scope of Change)

blocks.zh: 12.2 Current Regulatory Filing Considerations — 各地區申報分類
blocks.en: 12.2 Current Regulatory Filing Considerations

blocks.zh: 美國申報解析
blocks.en: US Filing Analysis

blocks.zh: 核心概念：PAS 的本質
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Nature of a PAS

blocks.zh: Prior Approval Supplement（PAS）是美國最嚴格的申報類別——「先申請、獲批後才能使用」。四個月審查期意味著你的資本投資要等監管機關點頭才能產生商業價值。
blocks.en: Prior Approval Supplement (PAS) is the strictest US filing category: "file first, use only after approval". A four-month review period means your capital investment cannot generate commercial value until the regulator signs off.

blocks.zh: 為什麼隔離器導入觸發 PAS？因為它同時影響了兩個 FDA 最敏感的 CMC 要素：無菌保證系統（整個 Grade A 環境重新定義）和 HVAC 系統（空氣分類、壓差設計、氣流模式全部改變）。
blocks.en: Why does introducing an isolator trigger a PAS? Because it affects two of the CMC elements FDA is most sensitive about: the sterility assurance system (the whole Grade A environment is redefined) and the HVAC system (air classification, pressure differential design and airflow patterns all change).

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Grade A in Grade C/D
blocks.en: Key Point: Grade A in Grade C/D

blocks.zh: 這是隔離器最重要的設施優勢之一：ISO-5（Grade A）腔體可以安置在 ISO-7（Grade C）或 ISO-8（Grade D）背景環境中，不再需要 Grade B 背景區域。這大幅降低廠房面積要求與潔淨室建設成本——也是 CDMO 升級隔離器的財務計算之一。
blocks.en: This is one of the most important facility advantages of an isolator: an ISO 5 (Grade A) chamber can sit in an ISO 7 (Grade C) or ISO 8 (Grade D) background, so a Grade B background area is no longer needed. This greatly reduces floor-space requirements and cleanroom construction cost, and it is one part of the CDMO's financial case for upgrading to an isolator.

blocks.zh: 想像你在倉庫裡放了一個密封的無菌手術艙。艙外是一般倉庫，艙內是 Grade A。只要艙體完整，裡面就是無菌的——這就是隔離器改變設施設計邏輯的地方。
blocks.en: Imagine placing a sealed sterile surgical pod inside a warehouse. Outside the pod is an ordinary warehouse; inside is Grade A. As long as the pod stays intact, the inside is sterile. This is exactly how an isolator changes the logic of facility design.

blocks.zh: 如果你的廠目前有一間 Grade B 背景房，導入隔離器後可以降級為 Grade C。這個空間可以重新利用嗎？這個「省下來的潔淨室」如何在商業計劃書中量化為隔離器投資的間接收益？
blocks.en: If your site currently has a Grade B background room, it can be downgraded to Grade C after the isolator is introduced. Can that space be reused? How would you quantify this "saved cleanroom" in the business case as an indirect benefit of the isolator investment?

blocks.zh: 加拿大申報解析
blocks.en: Canada Filing Analysis

blocks.zh: 核心概念：等效 vs. 非等效
blocks.en: Key Concept: Equivalent vs. Non-equivalent

blocks.zh: 加拿大申報的關鍵判斷點是「新充填套間是否等效（equivalent）於現有套間」。這直接決定是走 Notifiable Change（90天）還是 SNDS（180天）。
blocks.en: The key decision point for a Canadian filing is whether the new filling suite is equivalent to the existing one. This directly determines whether you follow the Notifiable Change (90 days) or the SNDS (180 days) route.

blocks.zh: 隔離器導入通常屬於「非等效」變更——因為環境分類、設備配置、消毒方式都根本改變。因此較可能走 SNDS 路徑。
blocks.en: Introducing an isolator is usually a "non-equivalent" change, because the environmental classification, equipment configuration and decontamination method all change fundamentally. The SNDS route is therefore more likely.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：多產品 CDMO 的申報負擔
blocks.en: Key Point: The Filing Burden for a Multi-Product CDMO

blocks.zh: 「每個受影響產品需單獨申報」是 CDMO 在多客戶場景下的主要挑戰。如果你的充填線服務 8 個產品，理論上要提 8 份申請。
blocks.en: "Each affected product must be filed separately" is the main challenge for a CDMO with multiple clients. If your filling line serves 8 products, in theory you must submit 8 applications.

blocks.zh: 但 TR91 明確指出：如果充填範圍（vial size、fill volume）涵蓋所有產品，可以在一份申報中槓桿其他產品的數據——這正是 PACMP 設計範圍定義的重要性所在。
blocks.en: However, TR91 states clearly that if the filling range (vial size, fill volume) covers all products, data from other products can be leveraged within a single filing. This is exactly why the scope definition of the PACMP matters.

blocks.zh: 把多產品 CDMO 的申報想像成「一把鑰匙開多把鎖」的策略。如果 PACMP 的驗證範圍定義夠廣（覆蓋所有產品的充填規格），監管機關接受後，後續每個產品的申報就簡化為「通知」而非「重新審查」。
blocks.en: Think of a multi-product CDMO's filing approach as "one key that opens many locks". If the validation scope defined in the PACMP is broad enough (covering the filling specifications of all products), then once the regulator accepts it, each subsequent product filing is simplified to a "notification" rather than a fresh review.

blocks.zh: 歐盟申報解析
blocks.en: EU Filing Analysis

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Type II Major Variation
blocks.en: Key Concept: Type II Major Variation

blocks.zh: 歐盟的 Type II Variation 等同於美國的 PAS——都是「先批准才能使用」。關鍵條件是「可能對品質、安全性或有效性有重大影響」。
blocks.en: The EU Type II Variation is equivalent to the US PAS: both are "approval first, use afterwards". The key criterion is a "potentially significant impact on quality, safety or efficacy".

blocks.zh: 充填技術從 LAF 改為隔離器，無疑符合「substantial change to manufacturing process」的定義，因此分類為 Type II 幾乎是確定的。
blocks.en: Changing the filling technology from LAF to an isolator clearly meets the definition of a "substantial change to the manufacturing process", so classification as Type II is almost certain.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：多區域同步申報的複雜度
blocks.en: Key Point: The Complexity of Multi-Region Parallel Filings

blocks.zh: 如果一個產品在美國、歐盟、加拿大都有上市許可，同一個充填線變更需要同步提交 PAS（美國）+ Type II（歐盟）+ SNDS/Notifiable（加拿大）。三個地區的審查時程不一致，意味著你可能在某個市場獲批後，另一個市場還在審查中。
blocks.en: If a product holds marketing authorizations in the US, EU and Canada, the same filling line change requires parallel submissions: PAS (US) + Type II (EU) + SNDS/Notifiable Change (Canada). Review timelines differ across the three regions, so you may be approved in one market while another is still under review.

blocks.zh: PACMP 策略的核心價值之一，就是用一份預先同意的協議，讓後續申報在所有地區都走「快速通道」。
blocks.en: One of the core values of the PACMP strategy is that a single pre-agreed protocol lets the subsequent filings follow a "fast track" in every region.

blocks.zh: WHO 申報解析
blocks.en: WHO Filing Analysis

blocks.zh: 核心概念：WHO 的重要性
blocks.en: Key Concept: Why WHO Matters

blocks.zh: WHO 指引對許多新興市場國家（東南亞、非洲、拉丁美洲）的監管機關具有直接參考效力。如果你的 CDMO 服務有 WHO 預認證（PQ）產品（如疫苗、基本藥物），就必須遵循 WHO 程序。
blocks.en: WHO guidance carries direct reference value for the regulators of many emerging-market countries (Southeast Asia, Africa, Latin America). If your CDMO serves WHO-prequalified (PQ) products (such as vaccines or essential medicines), you must follow WHO procedures.

blocks.zh: 「中度品質變更」（moderate quality change）在 WHO 框架中需要事前批准，這與美國 PAS、歐盟 Type II 的邏輯一致——所有主要法規體系都要求「先批准，後使用」。
blocks.en: A "moderate quality change" under the WHO framework requires prior approval. This is consistent with the logic of the US PAS and EU Type II: every major regulatory system requires "approval first, use afterwards".

blocks.zh: 12.3 Strategy — 申報策略與 PACMP 框架
blocks.en: 12.3 Strategy: Filing Strategy and the PACMP Framework

blocks.zh: 策略解析：PACMP 的財務價值
blocks.en: Strategy Analysis: The Financial Value of a PACMP

blocks.zh: 核心概念：PACMP 如何「解鎖」變更
blocks.en: Key Concept: How a PACMP "Unlocks" the Change

blocks.zh: 這張表格的精髓在最後兩欄的對比：
blocks.en: The essence of this table is the contrast between the last two columns:

blocks.zh: 現在（Current）：每個受影響產品都要走 PAS/Type II，先等批准才能用新設備。
blocks.en: Current: every affected product goes through a PAS/Type II and must wait for approval before using the new equipment.

blocks.zh: 未來（Proposed with PACMP）：PACMP 本身走一次 PAS，之後每個產品只需提「履行承諾的通知」（Do and Tell）。
blocks.en: Future (Proposed with PACMP): the PACMP itself goes through a PAS once, and afterwards each product only needs to submit a "notification of fulfilled commitments" (Do and Tell).

blocks.zh: 這就是 PACMP 的商業價值：把「重複的個案審查」轉換為「一次性預先同意 + 後續快速通道」。
blocks.en: This is the commercial value of a PACMP: it converts "repeated case-by-case review" into "one-time advance agreement plus a fast track afterwards".

blocks.zh: 重點提示：受影響的 CTD 章節
blocks.en: Key Point: Affected CTD Sections

blocks.zh: Table 12.3-1🔍 列出了所有需要更新的 CTD 章節，覆蓋面相當廣：
blocks.en: Table 12.3-1🔍 lists all the CTD sections that need updating, and the coverage is quite broad:

blocks.zh: 3.2.P.2.3 — 製造過程開發
blocks.en: 3.2.P.2.3: Manufacturing process development

blocks.zh: 3.2.P.3.3 — 製造過程描述及管制
blocks.en: 3.2.P.3.3: Description of manufacturing process and process controls

blocks.zh: 3.2.P.3.4 — 關鍵步驟管制
blocks.en: 3.2.P.3.4: Controls of critical steps
3.2.P.3.5: Process validation
3.2.P.5.4: Batch analyses

blocks.zh: 3.2.P.8 — 所有穩定性章節
blocks.en: 3.2.P.8: All stability sections

blocks.zh: 3.2.A.1 — 設施與設備
blocks.en: 3.2.A.1: Facilities and equipment

blocks.zh: 這說明隔離器導入不是「只換一台機器」，而是牽動整個 CMC 申報包的系統性變更。
blocks.en: This shows that introducing an isolator is not just "swapping one machine" but a systemic change that touches the whole CMC filing package.

blocks.zh: 類比說明：「先買地圖，後省路費」
blocks.en: Analogy: "Buy the Map First, Save on Tolls Later"

blocks.zh: PACMP 就像事先與政府協商好一條「快速通關走廊」。你花一次時間和成本（PACMP 申請、與 FDA 開 presubmission meeting），換來之後每個產品走這條走廊的通行證。
blocks.en: A PACMP is like negotiating a "fast-clearance corridor" with the government in advance. You spend time and cost once (the PACMP submission and a presubmission meeting with FDA), and in return you get a pass that every product can use on that corridor afterwards.

blocks.zh: 如果你的充填線服務 10 個產品，不做 PACMP 就要走 10 次 PAS（各等 4 個月）；做了 PACMP，那 10 個產品都走「Do and Tell」快速通道。
blocks.en: If your filling line serves 10 products, without a PACMP you would go through 10 PASs (about 4 months of waiting each); with a PACMP, all 10 products take the "Do and Tell" fast track.

blocks.zh: 你的廠有多少產品在這條充填線上？如果今天啟動隔離器升級計劃，估算一下：不做 PACMP vs. 做 PACMP，在監管等待時間和商業損失（Opportunity Cost）上各有多大差距？這個差距如何在資本支出提案中呈現？
blocks.en: How many products run on this filling line at your site? If you launched the isolator upgrade today, estimate the gap between no PACMP and with PACMP in regulatory waiting time and commercial loss (opportunity cost). How would you present that gap in the capital expenditure proposal?

blocks.zh: PACMP Document — Post-Approval Change Management Protocol (完整範例)
blocks.en: PACMP Document: Post-Approval Change Management Protocol (complete example)

blocks.zh: PACMP 目的與範圍解析
blocks.en: PACMP Purpose and Scope Analysis

blocks.zh: 核心概念：PACMP 的「Purpose Statement」要寫什麼
blocks.en: Key Concept: What the PACMP "Purpose Statement" Must Say

blocks.zh: 一份好的 PACMP Purpose Statement 要明確包含三個要素：
blocks.en: A good PACMP Purpose Statement must contain three elements:

blocks.zh: Who：針對哪個藥品（OFB = Ourfavoritebiologic，在真實案例中就是產品名稱）
blocks.en: Who: which drug product (OFB = Ourfavoritebiologic; in a real case this is the product name)

blocks.zh: What：什麼變更（導入隔離器替代 LAF）
blocks.en: What: what change (introducing an isolator to replace LAF)

blocks.zh: How：如何證明可接受性（比較性研究 + 預定義驗收標準）
blocks.en: How: how acceptability will be demonstrated (comparability study plus predefined acceptance criteria)

blocks.zh: 這三個要素缺一不可。Purpose Statement 決定了監管機關如何理解你的申報意圖。
blocks.en: None of the three can be omitted. The Purpose Statement determines how the regulator understands the intent of your filing.

blocks.zh: 類比說明：為什麼是隔離器而非機器人工作艙？
blocks.en: Analogy: Why an Isolator and Not a Robotic Workcell?

blocks.zh: 機器人工作艙（gloveless）在技術上是最優的，但對已核准產品進行這麼大的設備變更，監管風險也最高。隔離器在業界已有充足的驗證文獻和監管接受度，是「最佳可行技術」而非「最理想理論技術」。
blocks.en: A robotic workcell (gloveless) is technically optimal, but making such a large equipment change to an approved product also carries the highest regulatory risk. Isolators have ample validation literature and regulatory acceptance in industry, so they are the "best available technology" rather than the "ideal theoretical technology".

blocks.zh: 重點提示：三種隔離技術的選擇矩陣
blocks.en: Key Point: Selection Matrix for the Three Isolation Technologies

blocks.zh: 本 PACMP 選擇隔離器作為最平衡的解決方案——比 Closed RABS 更高的無菌保證，比機器人工作艙更成熟的技術與驗證基礎。
blocks.en: This PACMP chooses the isolator as the most balanced solution: higher sterility assurance than closed RABS, and a more mature technology and validation base than a robotic workcell.

blocks.zh: 魚骨圖解析：CQA/CPP 全景地圖
blocks.en: Fishbone Analysis: The CQA/CPP Overview Map

blocks.zh: 核心概念：魚骨圖在 PACMP 中的角色
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Role of the Fishbone in a PACMP

blocks.zh: Figure 12-1 不是裝飾性圖表，它是比較性研究設計的「需求說明書」。每一個魚骨分支代表一個需要在 PACMP 中評估的風險維度：
blocks.en: Figure 12-1 is not a decorative chart; it is the "requirements specification" for the comparability study design. Each fishbone branch represents a risk dimension that must be evaluated in the PACMP:

blocks.zh: 如果這個 CQA/CPP 受到隔離器導入影響，就必須設計對應的研究來證明等效性或改善。
blocks.en: If a CQA/CPP is affected by introducing the isolator, a corresponding study must be designed to demonstrate equivalence or improvement.

blocks.zh: 如果沒有影響，要有書面理由說明為什麼不受影響。
blocks.en: If it is not affected, there must be a written rationale explaining why.

blocks.zh: 換句話說，魚骨圖幫你做「完備性檢查」（completeness check）——確保沒有遺漏任何監管機關可能質疑的面向。
blocks.en: In other words, the fishbone gives you a "completeness check", ensuring that no aspect the regulator might question has been overlooked.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：E&L 是隔離器導入最複雜的 CQA
blocks.en: Key Point: E&L Is the Most Complex CQA in an Isolator Introduction

blocks.zh: 隔離器導入帶來兩個新的 E&L 風險來源：
blocks.en: Introducing the isolator brings two new E&L risk sources:

blocks.zh: 泵型改變：從隔膜泵（diaphragm pump）改為蠕動泵（peristaltic pump）——新的矽膠管接觸產品，必須評估矽膠 leachables 對蛋白質療法的影響。
blocks.en: Pump type change: moving from a diaphragm pump to a peristaltic pump means new silicone tubing contacts the product, so the impact of silicone leachables on the protein therapeutic must be evaluated.

blocks.zh: H₂O₂ 殘留：VHP 消毒循環後，隔離器腔體內可能有微量 H₂O₂ 殘留，這是隔離器特有的化學污染風險，在傳統 LAF 中不存在。
blocks.en: H₂O₂ residue: after a VHP decontamination cycle, trace H₂O₂ may remain in the isolator chamber. This is a chemical contamination risk specific to isolators and does not exist in a conventional LAF.

blocks.zh: 本 PACMP 已明確說明：實驗室研究（pump shear study）已完成，確認新泵不會負面影響產品品質。
blocks.en: This PACMP states explicitly that the laboratory study (pump shear study) has been completed and confirms that the new pump does not adversely affect product quality.

blocks.zh: 蠕動泵 vs. 隔膜泵：對蛋白質的潛在剪切風險
blocks.en: Peristaltic vs. Diaphragm Pump: Potential Shear Risk to Proteins

blocks.zh: 蠕動泵透過擠壓矽膠管來驅動液體，這個「擠壓-釋放」循環在理論上會產生剪切力（shear force），對分子量大、結構敏感的蛋白質療法（如單克隆抗體）可能造成聚集（aggregation）。
blocks.en: A peristaltic pump moves liquid by squeezing silicone tubing. In theory this "squeeze-release" cycle generates shear force that may cause aggregation in large, structurally sensitive protein therapeutics (such as monoclonal antibodies).

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼 PACMP 要求做「pump laboratory study」——在工程批次前先驗證新泵的操作參數不會觸發蛋白質降解。這是監管機關最可能質疑的技術問題之一。
blocks.en: This is why the PACMP requires a "pump laboratory study": to verify, before the engineering runs, that the operating parameters of the new pump do not trigger protein degradation. This is one of the technical questions the regulator is most likely to raise.

blocks.zh: 在你的充填線上，哪個 CQA 是目前最難監控的？導入隔離器後，哪個 CQA 會因為「降低人員介入」而改善？哪個 CQA 會因為「新增 H₂O₂ 消毒循環」而引入新的風險？請用魚骨圖的框架思考。
blocks.en: On your filling line, which CQA is currently the hardest to monitor? After introducing the isolator, which CQA will improve because of "reduced personnel intervention"? Which CQA will carry new risk because of the "added H₂O₂ decontamination cycle"? Think it through using the fishbone framework.

blocks.zh: 背景資料解析：建立「Before」基線
blocks.en: Background Data Analysis: Establishing the "Before" Baseline

blocks.zh: 核心概念：為什麼需要詳細的現況描述
blocks.en: Key Concept: Why a Detailed Description of the Current State Is Needed

blocks.zh: PACMP 的比較性研究（comparability study）核心邏輯是「新 = 舊的等效或更優」。要證明這一點，你必須先把「舊的」說清楚。
blocks.en: The core logic of the PACMP comparability study is "new is equivalent to or better than old". To prove this, you must first describe the "old" clearly.

blocks.zh: Table 12-1 到 12-4 就是在建立這個基線（baseline）。監管機關審查 PACMP 時，首先會確認：你的現況描述是否完整準確？如果現況描述不完整，後面的比較就失去參照點。
blocks.en: Tables 12-1 to 12-4 establish this baseline. When reviewing a PACMP, the regulator first checks whether your description of the current state is complete and accurate. If it is incomplete, the later comparison loses its reference point.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：CCI 測試的重要性升級
blocks.en: Key Point: CCI Testing Becomes More Important

blocks.zh: 隔離器導入改變了封裝工序的機械動作（stoppered、capped 方式可能改變），因此 Container Closure Integrity (CCI) 測試是必做的。
blocks.en: Introducing the isolator changes the mechanical actions of the closing operation (the way stoppering and capping are done may change), so Container Closure Integrity (CCI) testing is mandatory.

blocks.zh: TR91 明確指出，對於製程改變可能影響容器密封完整性的情況，必須進行 CCI 評估。可接受的方法包括：氣泡測試、壓力/真空衰減、示蹤氣體滲漏、染料穿透，或微生物挑戰測試。
blocks.en: TR91 states clearly that CCI evaluation must be performed wherever a process change may affect container closure integrity. Acceptable methods include bubble test, pressure/vacuum decay, tracer gas leak testing, dye ingress, or microbial challenge testing.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Polysorbate 80 的監控意義
blocks.en: Key Point: Why Polysorbate 80 Needs Monitoring

blocks.zh: CQA 表中列出了 Polysorbate 80 (PS80) 的 assay——這個非活性成分的監控在蛋白質製劑中非常關鍵。PS80 保護蛋白質在充填過程中不受介面剪切應力破壞。
blocks.en: The CQA table lists the Polysorbate 80 (PS80) assay. Monitoring this excipient is critical in protein formulations, because PS80 protects the protein from interfacial shear stress during filling.

blocks.zh: 泵型改變（隔膜泵 → 蠕動泵）改變了剪切力模式，理論上可能影響 PS80 的消耗速率，進而影響蛋白質穩定性。這是工程批次研究中必須監控的 CQA。
blocks.en: The pump change (diaphragm pump to peristaltic pump) alters the shear pattern, which in theory could affect the PS80 depletion rate and in turn protein stability. This is a CQA that must be monitored in the engineering run studies.

blocks.zh: 類比說明：現況記錄是你的「健康基線」
blocks.en: Analogy: The Current-State Record Is Your "Health Baseline"

blocks.zh: 在做健康檢查前，醫生需要知道你的基線數據（血壓、血糖、膽固醇）。PACMP 的 Background 章節就是藥品的「健康基線報告」——告訴監管機關：在做任何改變之前，這個產品的狀態是這樣的。
blocks.en: Before a health check-up, the doctor needs your baseline data (blood pressure, blood glucose, cholesterol). The Background section of a PACMP is the product's "health baseline report": it tells the regulator what state this product was in before any change was made.

blocks.zh: 計畫變更解析：新隔離器的技術細節
blocks.en: Planned Changes Analysis: Technical Details of the New Isolator

blocks.zh: 核心概念：H₂O₂ VHP 消毒循環的驗證
blocks.en: Key Concept: Validation of the H₂O₂ VHP Decontamination Cycle

blocks.zh: Vapor Phase Hydrogen Peroxide (VHP) 是隔離器腔體的標準消毒方法。每次換批（campaign changeover）前，系統自動執行一個 VHP 循環：
blocks.en: Vapor Phase Hydrogen Peroxide (VHP) is the standard method for decontaminating an isolator chamber. Before each campaign changeover, the system automatically runs a VHP cycle:

blocks.zh: 注入（Injection）：氣化 H₂O₂ 充滿腔體
blocks.en: Injection: vaporized H₂O₂ fills the chamber

blocks.zh: 保持（Dwell）：達到目標濃度並維持足夠時間（log reduction 驗證）
blocks.en: Dwell: the target concentration is reached and held for long enough (verified by log reduction)

blocks.zh: 通風（Aeration）：排除 H₂O₂ 殘留，確保殘留低於安全限值
blocks.en: Aeration: H₂O₂ residue is removed, ensuring residual levels fall below the safe limit

blocks.zh: 這個循環本身需要驗證（VHP cycle validation），並且必須在 PACMP / PPQ 中描述。每次消毒循環的 H₂O₂ 濃度、接觸時間、殘留水平都是 CPP。
blocks.en: This cycle itself needs validation (VHP cycle validation) and must be described in the PACMP/PPQ. The H₂O₂ concentration, contact time and residual level of each decontamination cycle are CPPs.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：填充重量頻率的改善
blocks.en: Key Point: Improved Fill Weight Check Frequency

blocks.zh: 注意 Table 12-1 vs. Table 12-5 的關鍵差異：填充重量檢查頻率從每 5% 批量改善為每 1% 批量。
blocks.en: Note the key difference between Table 12-1 and Table 12-5: the fill weight check frequency improves from every 5% of the batch to every 1% of the batch.

blocks.zh: 這是隔離器帶來的製程改善——蠕動泵的精確度更高，使得高頻率重量監控成為可行（且有意義）的製程控制手段。這也是監管機關樂於看到的「改善幅度」（不只是等效，而是更好）。
blocks.en: This is a process improvement the isolator brings: the peristaltic pump is more accurate, which makes high-frequency weight monitoring feasible (and meaningful) as a process control. It is also the kind of "improvement margin" regulators like to see (not just equivalent, but better).

blocks.zh: 重點提示：驗證的完整架構
blocks.en: Key Point: The Complete Validation Framework

blocks.zh: FAT → SAT → IQ → OQ → PQ/PPQ 是隔離器導入的完整驗證路徑：
blocks.en: FAT → SAT → IQ → OQ → PQ/PPQ is the complete validation path for introducing an isolator:

blocks.zh: FAT：在製造商廠房驗收設備
blocks.en: FAT: accept the equipment at the manufacturer's site

blocks.zh: SAT：在自己廠房安裝後驗收
blocks.en: SAT: accept it after installation at your own site

blocks.zh: IQ：確認設備按設計安裝
blocks.en: IQ: confirm the equipment is installed as designed

blocks.zh: OQ：確認設備按設計運作
blocks.en: OQ: confirm the equipment operates as designed

blocks.zh: PPQ：確認設備在實際生產條件下持續生產符合規格的產品
blocks.en: PPQ: confirm the equipment consistently produces product that meets specification under actual production conditions

blocks.zh: PPQ 是 PACMP 中最核心的驗證活動，其結果將成為每個受影響產品申報的支撐數據。
blocks.en: PPQ is the most central validation activity in the PACMP, and its results become the supporting data for each affected product's filing.

blocks.zh: 在規劃隔離器 FAT 時，你會要求製造商重現哪些關鍵測試？VHP 循環確認？壓力保持測試？媒體充填模擬？如果 FAT 在海外供應商廠房進行，你如何確保 FAT 結果可以被 FDA 接受（而非需要在 SAT 重做全部測試）？
blocks.en: When planning the isolator FAT, which key tests will you ask the manufacturer to reproduce? VHP cycle confirmation? Pressure hold test? Media fill simulation? If the FAT is held at an overseas supplier's site, how do you ensure the FAT results will be accepted by FDA (rather than having to repeat all the tests at SAT)?

blocks.zh: 影響評估 & CTD 更新解析
blocks.en: Impact Assessment & CTD Update Analysis

blocks.zh: 核心概念：「No change proposed」的重要性
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Importance of "No change proposed"

blocks.zh: Table 12-6 中大量使用「No change proposed」。這些聲明同樣重要——它們是風險評估的邊界定義，告訴監管機關：我們已經系統性地評估了所有步驟，並且確認了哪些是受影響的、哪些是不受影響的。
blocks.en: Table 12-6 makes extensive use of "No change proposed". These statements matter just as much: they define the boundary of the risk assessment, telling the regulator that you have systematically assessed every step and confirmed which are affected and which are not.

blocks.zh: 沒有「No change」聲明，監管機關無法判斷你的評估是否完整。
blocks.en: Without "No change" statements, the regulator cannot judge whether your assessment is complete.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Table 12-7🔍 的穩定性策略
blocks.en: Key Point: Stability Strategy in Table 12-7🔍

blocks.zh: 穩定性數據要求：
blocks.en: Stability data requirements:

blocks.zh: 工程批次（Engineering runs）：至少 6 個月，包含加速條件和壓力條件
blocks.en: Engineering runs: at least 6 months, including accelerated and stress conditions

blocks.zh: PPQ 批次：第一批進長期穩定性計劃（real-time at 2–8°C，36 個月）
blocks.en: PPQ batches: the first batch enters the long-term stability program (real-time at 2–8°C, 36 months)

blocks.zh: 申報時：提供申報時已有的實時數據
blocks.en: At filing: provide the real-time data available at the time of filing

blocks.zh: 持續計畫：前三批 PPQ + 工程批次全部追蹤至保存期限；之後每年至少一批進穩定性
blocks.en: Ongoing program: the first three PPQ batches and all engineering runs are tracked through to expiry; after that, at least one batch per year enters the stability program

blocks.zh: 這個設計的邏輯是：在申報時不需要提交完整 36 個月數據，但要承諾後續的追蹤計畫。這是 PACMP 批准後「履行承諾」的一部分。
blocks.en: The logic of this design is that the complete 36-month data set is not needed at filing, but you must commit to the follow-up tracking program. This is part of "fulfilling the commitments" after the PACMP is approved.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：3.2.A.1 設施與設備的範圍
blocks.en: Key Point: Scope of 3.2.A.1 Facilities and Equipment

blocks.zh: 3.2.A.1 的更新範圍最廣，包含：
blocks.en: 3.2.A.1 has the widest update scope, including:

blocks.zh: 廠房平面圖（含房間等級標示）
blocks.en: Facility floor plans (with room grades marked)

blocks.zh: HVAC 系統圖
blocks.en: HVAC system diagrams

blocks.zh: 水系統圖
blocks.en: Water system diagrams

blocks.zh: 環境監控數據
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring data

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證摘要
blocks.en: Cleaning validation summary

blocks.zh: 換批程序
blocks.en: Changeover procedures

blocks.zh: 這反映了隔離器導入對設施面的深度影響——它不只是「換一台機器」，而是重新定義了廠房的整個環境管制架構。
blocks.en: This reflects the deep impact of an isolator introduction on the facility: it is not just "swapping one machine" but redefining the entire environmental control architecture of the plant.

blocks.zh: 思考題：你的 3.2.A.1 準備好了嗎？
blocks.en: Discussion Question: Is Your 3.2.A.1 Ready?

blocks.zh: 在你的廠，3.2.A.1 的廠房圖面和 HVAC 系統圖是否與實際狀況一致、即時更新？如果現在啟動隔離器導入計劃，你需要多少時間來更新這些文件至申報就緒狀態？這個工作量是否已被納入項目時程規劃？
blocks.en: At your site, are the 3.2.A.1 floor plans and HVAC diagrams consistent with the actual situation and kept current? If you launched the isolator project now, how long would you need to bring these documents up to filing-ready status? Has this workload been included in the project timeline?

blocks.zh: 整體 PACMP 邏輯回顧
blocks.en: Recap of the Overall PACMP Logic

blocks.zh: 整個 PACMP 文件的結構可以用這個邏輯鏈理解：
blocks.en: The structure of the whole PACMP document can be understood through this logic chain:

blocks.zh: Purpose：我要做什麼，為了什麼
blocks.en: Purpose: what I am doing and why

blocks.zh: Scope：變更的邊界在哪裡（哪些設備、哪些製程步驟）
blocks.en: Scope: where the boundary of the change lies (which equipment, which process steps)

blocks.zh: Background：現在的狀態是什麼（基線）
blocks.en: Background: what the current state is (baseline)

blocks.zh: Figure 12-1 魚骨圖：哪些 CQA/CPP 可能受影響（風險識別）
blocks.en: Figure 12-1 fishbone: which CQAs/CPPs may be affected (risk identification)

blocks.zh: Planned Changes：新系統的技術細節
blocks.en: Planned Changes: technical details of the new system

blocks.zh: Table 12-6 影響評估：每個步驟受影響程度（風險評估）
blocks.en: Table 12-6 impact assessment: the degree to which each step is affected (risk assessment)

blocks.zh: Table 12-7🔍 研究計畫：如何證明等效性（驗證策略）
blocks.en: Table 12-7🔍 study plan: how equivalence will be demonstrated (validation strategy)

blocks.zh: 後續：PPQ 執行 → 數據提交 → 承諾履行 → 通知監管機關
blocks.en: Follow-up: PPQ execution → data submission → commitments fulfilled → regulator notified

blocks.zh: 章節摘要 — Section 12a Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary: Section 12a Summary

blocks.zh: 本附錄的核心命題：LAF 充填線升級為隔離器是一個典型的「多地區重大變更」，在美國（PAS）、歐盟（Type II）、加拿大（SNDS/Notifiable）、WHO（中度品質變更）都需要事前批准。沒有策略的申報方式將導致每個產品的等待時間加總，嚴重拖累商業上市。
blocks.en: Core proposition of this appendix: upgrading an LAF filling line to an isolator is a typical "multi-region major change" that requires prior approval in the US (PAS), EU (Type II), Canada (SNDS/Notifiable Change) and WHO (moderate quality change). Filing without a strategy means the waiting times for each product add up, seriously delaying commercial launch.

blocks.zh: PACMP 是核心解方：透過 ICH Q12 框架，PACMP 把「一次性監管預先同意」轉換為後續所有受影響產品的快速申報通道（Do and Tell）。這是資本投資計劃書必須呈現的法規財務效益。
blocks.en: The PACMP is the core solution: through the ICH Q12 framework, the PACMP converts "one-time advance regulatory agreement" into a fast filing route (Do and Tell) for all subsequent affected products. This is the regulatory and financial benefit that a capital investment proposal must present.

blocks.zh: Figure 12-1 魚骨圖的實務價值：覆蓋 Sterility、Fill Weight、Particulates、E&L（含泵型改變的剪切力風險）、CCI 五大 CQA 維度，是比較性研究設計的完備性檢查工具。
blocks.en: Practical value of the Figure 12-1 fishbone: covering five CQA dimensions (sterility, fill weight, particulates, E&L (including the shear risk from the pump change) and CCI), it is a completeness-check tool for the comparability study design.

blocks.zh: 最關鍵的技術差異點：隔膜泵 → 蠕動泵（剪切力研究必做）；無 H₂O₂ → VHP 自動消毒循環（消毒驗證 + H₂O₂ 殘留評估必做）；Grade B 背景 → Grade C/D 背景（廠房改造 + HVAC 重新設計）。
blocks.en: The most critical technical differences: diaphragm pump → peristaltic pump (shear study is mandatory); no H₂O₂ → automated VHP decontamination cycle (decontamination validation and H₂O₂ residue assessment are mandatory); Grade B background → Grade C/D background (facility modification and HVAC redesign).

blocks.zh: Table 12-7🔍 的實務意義：CTD 更新範圍（P.2.3、P.3.3、P.3.4、P.3.5、P.5.4、P.8.1/2/3、A.1）提供了一份完整的申報工作清單，可直接用於隔離器導入項目的法規工作分解結構（WBS）。
blocks.en: Practical significance of Table 12-7🔍: the CTD update scope (P.2.3, P.3.3, P.3.4, P.3.5, P.5.4, P.8.1/2/3, A.1) provides a complete filing work list that can be used directly as the regulatory work breakdown structure (WBS) for an isolator introduction project.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的戰略意義：成功完成隔離器升級並獲得 PACMP 批准，代表你的設施可以承接更高無菌保證需求的客戶產品（活性生物製劑、毒性療法、高敏感蛋白質），是 CDMO 業務組合升級的重要里程碑。
blocks.en: Strategic significance for a CDMO: successfully completing the isolator upgrade and obtaining PACMP approval means your facility can take on client products that need a higher level of sterility assurance (live biologics, toxic therapies, highly sensitive proteins), an important milestone in upgrading the CDMO's business portfolio.
